messages:
Marco: Heads-up — p95 CPU on prod-runtime spiked to ~87% across eu-west-1 starting ~11:03. Spinning up a quick bridge to triage. Join if you can: https://meet.redwood.com/triage/abc123 :rotating_light:
Priya: on it. Can you confirm which service? runtime/generation or router?
Marco: runtime-serve v3 on nodepool-5, `model-infer` pods. Logs show repeated `tok_io` spikes. Pasting `kubectl top` snippet in a sec.
Ellen: I'm offline for the next 10, can hop in by 11:15 if still running.
deploy-bot: [system] Deploy `runtime-serve` v3.2.1 rolled out at 10:58 in eu-west-1
Jules: Joining bridge now — ETA 2m. @Priya can you grab heap / p95 traces?
Priya: grabbing traces, will dump pprof to s3: s3://redwood-ops/tmp/pprof-1812345678.pb.gz
Marco: Agenda for quick triage: 1) confirm regression vs config change 2) isolate nodepool-5 offender 3) rollback plan if needed (canary to v3.2.0).
Jules: quick look at logs shows repeating latency marker, not OOM. Might be hot loop in native kernels.
Priya: small log snippet: ```[ERROR] token_dispatcher.cpp:142 - wait > 200ms```
Marco: ok run `strace` on top offender. Jules, can you run `ssh node-5-12 sudo perf top`?
Jules: perf top noisy — hotspots: `kv_cache::lookup`, `attention::compute`
Ellen: kicking off temporary +2 nodes in pool via autoscaler now.
Marco: if rollback is required we have the pre-approved rollback playbook: https://wiki.redwood/internal/rollback-playbook
Priya: posting pprof to s3 now and joining the bridge: https://meet.redwood.com/triage/abc123
Jules: I see GPU memcopy latency spikes. Locally lowering batch size to 8 reduces p95 — testing `--batch-max=8`.
Priya: pprof upload: https://s3.console.aws.amazon.com/s3/object/redwood-ops/tmp/pprof-1812345678.pb.gz (public access blocked)
Marco: thanks. @Ellen if scale-up doesn't stabilize in 10m we plan rollback.
deploy-bot: [system] Autoscaler increased nodepool-5 by +2 at 11:09
Priya: metrics trending down after +2 nodes: p95 360ms -> 120ms. Investigating further.
Jules: tentative root cause: new fused kernel shipped in v3.2.1 regresses memcopy under certain seq lengths. Opening issue: https://github.com/redwood/repro/issues/412
Marco: postmortem owners: Jules + Priya. If rollback triggered we'll mark incident and run playbook.
Priya: I'll start a revert PR for the fused kernel and collect more traces. Ping me for reviews.
Jules: thanks all — monitoring from bridge. :thumbsup:
